n_note: 295 candidates documented by 19 September 2026. Each experiment adds its trials; measurements add none, audits add none. E03 was left out of the running count used by E05 to E08 (their N was one too low); it is counted here.

experiments.title: Intraday momentum, flat before the overnight rollover
experiments.summary: The morning did not predict the afternoon. It lost money even before trading costs, and after costs it did no better than guessing at random.

experiments.title: Intraday momentum on metals and energy, 2014 to 2020 (data E01 never saw)
experiments.summary: On six years E01 never saw, metals and oil showed a small real tendency before costs, but paying the spread every day wiped it out. Not tradeable here.

experiments.title: Order-book imbalance predicts the next minute, net of costs (XRPUSD; amended: BTC/ETH/SOL depth is synthetic)
experiments.summary: Order-book pressure on XRP did not make money after crossing the spread twice. 11 simulated trades over 120 hours.

experiments.title: What a real fill costs: 20 live probes on EURUSD
experiments.summary: Real orders filled at the quoted price, on average a hair better. 20 round trips cost $1.31 in total, as the cost model assumed. Backtest costs are not understated for this pair.

experiments.title: Ethereum 20-day trend, tested on history and traded live
experiments.summary: The first rule to pass: following the last 20 days of Ethereum made money after costs over 9 years, in 6 of 8 years. The evidence is modest. It traded live until 23 September 2026, when E07 replaced it.

experiments.title: Does breadth add? The Ethereum trend rule across eight coins, combined
experiments.summary: Trading the rule on 8 coins made the result four times steadier than the average coin, but it did not beat Ethereum alone: some coins had no edge and diluted it. Breadth works only with components that each earn their place.

experiments.title: The Ethereum trend rule without a profit target (let winners run)
experiments.summary: Letting winning trades run instead of taking profit early did better: 0.80 against 0.58, with half as many trades. It is now the rule the engine trades.

experiments.title: The live trend rule on the five currency pairs the account can afford
experiments.summary: Of the five currency pairs the account can afford, only USD/SGD made money with the trend rule (0.15, 7 of 11 years), and only just: it barely survives doubled costs and could be luck. The other four lost. USD/SGD may trade beside Ethereum, but only away from the 21:00 UTC rollover when spreads widen.

experiments.title: Audit of the two live rules with stronger tests (10,000 null draws, block bootstrap, both halves)
experiments.summary: Both live rules failed the stronger tests and are demoted (no new trades). Ethereum: beat 10,000 random-sign runs and its bootstrap interval stays above zero, but all its edge is in 2018 to 2022; the half from September 2022 is slightly negative (-0.04). USDSGD: 28% of bootstrap resamples at or below zero, so its edge cannot be told from none.

experiments.title: Short Ethereum only when perpetual funding is high (crypto carry, out of sample 2022-2026)
experiments.summary: Shorting Ethereum when perpetual funding was high lost money on data the source paper never saw (Feb 2022 to Aug 2026): 23 shorts, 13 stopped out, net -45%, worse than randomly timed shorts (random average +0.1% a short, this rule -1.9%). High funding came during rallies that kept going. It also lost in the paper's own period and with BitMEX funding. Not tradeable here.

experiments.title: Six evidence families across the 60 instruments the broker offers (screen for forward tests)
experiments.summary: Screened six families with published evidence (time-series momentum, FX carry, currency cross-sectional momentum, short-term reversal, turn of month, time of day) on the 60 instruments with enough daily history, 2015 to 2026-09-15, net of measured spread, commission and financing: 431 trials, 0 IN, 199 OUT, 232 UNDECIDED. Best t 2.70 (turn of month, BTCUSD), under the 3.0 bar for a new family. No forward candidate. Programme P1 is fully spent with no live rule left (E07, E08 demoted by A01).

experiments.title: The dollar around the European currency fixes (ECB and London), out of sample 2020-2026
experiments.summary: Out of sample 2020 to 2026-09 at Dukascopy bid/ask plus 0.35 bps commission, the EURUSD+GBPUSD book lost: mean -1.97 bps a day, net Sharpe -0.91, t -2.35, 1,734 days; under the random-timing null p95 (-0.62); negative in 6 of 7 years. Inside the paper's years (2015-2019) it was only +1.32 bps a day, t 1.35. All 9 diagnostics negative. The published reversal is gone after costs, as the authors' decay warning suggested.

experiments.title: Short the dollar on scheduled Fed decision days, out of sample 2014-2026
experiments.summary: Short the dollar against 7 majors from 16:00 ET the day before each scheduled FOMC day to 16:00 ET on the day, 99 events 2014 to 2026-09: mean +5.70 bps net, t 0.97 (bar 2.0). It beats the random-day null p95 (4.55 bps), stays positive at 1.5x costs (4.45) and in both halves (5.8 and 5.6 bps), so the sign agrees with the paper, but 8 events a year cannot prove it. FAIL on criterion 1; deflated Sharpe 0.45. Not a forward candidate.

experiments.title: Every hourly intraday window on 7 FX majors, searched on 2014-2022, short list tested once on a sealed 2023-2026 vault
